relations.text: 2024年7月29日付で、Wells Fargo Bank, National Associationなどと1億2,500万ドルの回転与信枠を持つ5年物の担保付き契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Entered into a five-year secured revolving credit agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association and others on July 29, 2024, providing a $125.0 million revolving line of credit

source.label: Q2 Holdings 10-K
source.quote: We entered into a five-year secured revolving credit agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, Wells Fargo Securities, LLC and Texas Capital Bank on July 29, 2024, the Revolving Credit Agreement, which provides for a $125.0 million revolving line of credit, none of which was drawn as of December 31, 2025.
source.note: 2025年12月31日時点で未使用です。資金調達のみの関係です。
source.note_en: Undrawn as of December 31, 2025; financing relationship only.
